'''Jumara 24 (February 11)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Elayne]] orders the recruitment of mercenaries and Hunters for the [[Horn of Valere|Horn]] to increase the palace guard.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Mazrim Taim]] arrives to Elayne's summons and agrees to allow the [[Black Tower]] to be inspected.
*[[1000 NE]] - Elayne and [[Aviendha]] are bonded as first sisters.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Rand]] and [[Min]] continue to lay a false trail for the renegade [[Asha'man]] in [[Tear]].
